title: Report: Patriots tried to stop New York Post from publishing the Mike Vrabel-Dianna Russini photos

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Patriots tried to stop New York Post from publishing the Mike Vrabel-Dianna Russini photos
sources.description: Nearly two weeks after the New York Post first published photos of Patriots coach Mike Vrabel and former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini at an adults-only resort in Sedona, Arizona, the story finds new ways to remain relevant.
